variants.name: Chicken Breast, 5 × 14 g
variants.about_this_item:
• liquid snack
  • ideal for enhancing dry food
  • taurin boosts vision and prevents deficiency symptoms
  • contains valuable vitamins
  • supports fluid intake
  • very high acceptance
  • strong reward effect
  • ideal for freezing, e.g. in a licking mat

Delicious and easy to support the liquid intake of a cat You want to make your cat's dry food more palatable? Our liquid Creamy Snack in three different varieties is ideal for this. The cat snack is rich in valuable vitamins - taurine also strengthens your cat's eyesight and prevents deficiency symptoms. The liquid form also promotes the fluid intake of your velvet paw, whether you feed the snack separately or refine and spice up the dry food with it. The delicious snack also impresses with a great reward effect and its very high acceptance by cats!
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: chicken breast (36 %), tapioca starch gluten-free formula no added sugar Store in a cool and dry place.

Analytical constituents: Fat content 0.1 %, Moisture content 90.0 %, Protein 6.5 %, Crude ash 2.0 %, Crude fibre 1.0 %

Additives: Calcium-D-Pantothenat 1.47, Nicotinic acid 1.47, Taurine 800, Vit. A 780, Vit. B2 0.29, Vit. D3 5.25, Vit. E 0.75
